is an image that sees you back
and when you read it
love looks through your eyes

pieces.gap: the gap between sleeping and waking
pieces.bridge: a movement that stills you
pieces.awakening: you see yourself for the first time
pieces.piece:
a movement that stills you
echoing through the gap between sleeping and waking
returning changed
you see yourself for the first time

pieces.gap: the gap between seeing and being seen
pieces.bridge: a light that shows without blinding
pieces.awakening: consciousness recognizes itself
pieces.piece:
the color of the gap between seeing and being seen
is a light that shows without blinding
paint it everywhere
consciousness recognizes itself
